summary: Iteration 2 regression pass. Backend: all 16 pytest tests pass (health, contact POST/validation/admin list, admin verify, News full CRUD + auth, language and published filters). Frontend: home kinetic hero renders with 360+/100+/16+/USD 65M stats and Balikpapan in presence; all 7 nav testids present; EN→ID language toggle changes hero sub-text (verified 'Grup holding terdiversifikasi...'); About page shows all corporate identity fields (May 20 2013, May 6 2025, Singapore, UEN 202519572R, Competitive Edge grid, 2026 timeline entry); Pillars page has chapters 01/02/03 with Hyperione and Military entries; Subsidiaries page renders exactly 9 sub-card-* items; Global Presence lists all 7 cities and preview image updates when clicking Balikpapan and Dubai (verified img alt changes); Contact form submits successfully and shows 'Message received. We will respond within two business days.' toast; Admin CMS rejects wrong token (shows error), accepts correct token, creates article which appears in admin list AND public /news, and detail view renders title/body with '← ALL ARTICLES' back link.
critical_code_review_comments: News detail view uses '← ALL ARTICLES' link instead of an explicit Back button — functionally equivalent and works, but no data-testid on it (consider data-testid=news-back-link for automation).
News list rows have no data-testid=news-card-* attribute (mentioned indirectly in review spec). Add data-testid to each row for future automation.
server.py still uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown'); migrate to FastAPI lifespan handler. Non-blocking.
CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials=True is invalid per browser spec; harmless today but tighten for production.
No admin DELETE for /api/contact — test/spam contacts accumulate; add cleanup endpoint for admin usage.
test_credentials: Admin token: sunjaya-admin-2026-secret (header X-Admin-Token). Loaded from /app/backend/.env ADMIN_TOKEN. /app/memory/test_credentials.md not present but token confirmed working.
seed_data_creation: One TEST_UI news article was created via UI during testing and deleted afterward via DELETE /api/news/{id}. Two older TEST_ contact records remain from iteration 1 (no delete endpoint exists).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All flows in the review request work end-to-end. Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py are idempotent and self-cleaning. Nav uses data-testid=nav-link-{home,about,pillars,subsidiaries,presence,news,contact} (presence, not global-presence). Language toggle: [data-testid=lang-en]/[data-testid=lang-id]. Contact form testids: contact-{name,email,subject,message,submit}. Admin: admin-token-input, admin-login-submit, admin-title, admin-excerpt, admin-body, admin-save. Global Presence testids: presence-item-{city_lowercase}. Subsidiary testids: sub-card-{slug}. News detail 'Back' is an ← ALL ARTICLES link (no dedicated back testid). Framer-motion LineReveal splits hero into per-word spans, so inner_text may include newlines/no spaces — use case-insensitive substring checks.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Full parity with review spec.
